items.statement: The submitted BiBr4 optimization is converged and frequency analysis establishes a minimum with no unaccounted imaginary mode.
items.expected: A converged optimization and completed harmonic frequency calculation are documented; imaginary frequencies are absent or explicitly explained.

items.statement: Six distinct low-frequency Bi/Br modes are retained and assigned before comparison.
items.expected: Six individually identified modes in the low-frequency Raman region have wavenumbers, atom-based assignments and validation context.

items.statement: The optimized local geometry is compared to the SI Bi–Br distances and Br–Bi–Br angles with explicit pairing and aggregate errors.
items.expected: Distance and angle MAE are reported in Å and degrees, with object identity and pairing notes.

items.statement: The six computed low-frequency modes are quantitatively compared with the observed Raman bands.
items.expected: A six-mode RMSD in cm−1 is reported with explicit mode pairing.
